items.exampleEn: The painter won international renown in his thirties.
items.exampleZh: 這位畫家三十多歲就享譽國際。

items.exampleEn: The news coverage of the storm lasted all night.
items.exampleZh: 關於暴風雨的新聞報導持續了一整夜。

items.exampleEn: On this old map, the river is depicted in blue.
items.exampleZh: 在這張舊地圖上，河流是用藍色描繪的。

items.exampleEn: She was chosen to portray a famous singer in the new film.
items.exampleZh: 她被選中在新電影裡飾演一位知名歌手。

items.exampleEn: The children's drawings give a lovely depiction of their town.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們的畫把他們的小鎮描繪得很美。

items.exampleEn: Some readers did not like the novel's portrayal of teenagers.
items.exampleZh: 有些讀者不喜歡這本小說對青少年的描寫。

items.exampleEn: We visited a lake reputed to have the clearest water in the country.
items.exampleZh: 我們去了一座據說湖水全國最清澈的湖。

items.exampleEn: The popularization of mobile phones changed how we read the news.
items.exampleZh: 手機的普及改變了我們看新聞的方式。

items.sentenceEn: The radio station gave the concert live coverage.
items.sentenceZh: 廣播電台現場轉播了那場音樂會。

items.audioEn: The festival has gained renown for its outdoor theater shows.
items.audioZh: 這個節慶以戶外劇場演出而聞名。

items.sentenceEn: Many films portray scientists as strange and lonely.
items.sentenceZh: 許多電影把科學家描繪成古怪又孤單的人。

items.sentenceEn: Her new book depicts life in a small fishing village.
items.sentenceZh: 她的新書描寫了小漁村裡的生活。

items.stemEn: The TV ____ of the football final reached millions of people.
items.stemZh: 足球決賽的電視轉播觸及了數百萬人。

items.stemEn: The museum's new show ____ daily life in ancient Egypt.
items.stemZh: 博物館的新展覽描繪了古埃及的日常生活。

items.passageEn: Ana Lee won renown for her portrayal of a village doctor in a popular TV drama. The show depicts the doctor as tired, funny and sometimes wrong, and many viewers say this depiction feels more real than older dramas. Critics also praise the series for its part in the popularization of local history, since each episode is based on a true story. The show's director is reputed to rewrite scenes the night before filming. He says that the media coverage after the first season was the biggest surprise of his career.
items.passageZh: Ana Lee 因為在一部熱門電視劇中飾演村醫而成名。這部劇把醫生描寫成會累、很有趣、有時也會犯錯的人，許多觀眾說，這樣的描寫比舊的戲劇更真實。評論家也稱讚這部影集讓地方歷史普及，因為每一集都改編自真實故事。據說這部劇的導演常在拍攝前一晚改寫場景。他說，第一季播出後的媒體報導，才是他職業生涯中最大的驚喜。

questions.questionZh: 很多觀眾覺得這部劇對醫生的描寫怎麼樣？
options: 感覺比舊的戲劇更真實
太過誇張，不像真正醫生會做的事

questions.questionZh: 導演說，最令他驚喜的是什麼？
options: 自己常在拍攝前一晚改劇本
觀眾很喜歡醫生這個角色
第一季播出後媒體報導的熱烈程度

items.promptZh: 這部紀錄片把這座城市描繪成一個友善的地方。
referenceEn: The documentary portrays the city as a friendly place.
In the documentary, the city is portrayed as a friendly place.
rubricZh: portray 表示「把…描繪成」，用法例如 portray A as B、be portrayed as 等
「紀錄片」可寫，例如 documentary、film 等
「友善的地方」可寫，例如 a friendly place、a welcoming place 等

items.promptZh: 她只用幾筆就把那隻貓畫得栩栩如生。
referenceEn: With just a few lines, she depicted the cat vividly.
She depicted the cat vividly with only a few lines.
rubricZh: 「畫得栩栩如生」用 depict（例如 depicted the cat vividly 等）
「只用幾筆」可寫，例如 with just a few lines、with only a few lines 等，放句首或句尾皆可
時態配合內容（例如 depicted、depicts 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正："Still, he says that the media coverage..."：Still 表讓步轉折，但前一句（導演據說常在拍攝前一晚改寫場景）不是與「媒體報導是最大驚喜」相對立的不利情況，連接詞沒有正確的承接對象（準則 §4）。建議刪 Still 或改寫前句。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 刪去 Still，中譯同步刪「不過」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：repute 最常見是名詞「名聲」（of good repute、a place of repute），本卡釋義與例句改教被動式 reputed「據說」。若刻意避開與 renown 同義可接受，但建議確認 CEFR-J C1 該字所列詞性；若列為名詞則第一義應為「名聲；聲譽」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 查 lexicon：repute 名詞列 C2、動詞列 C1，本課是 C1 課綱字，所以教動詞（be reputed to）；名詞「名聲」屬 C2，不教

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B：depiction 卡與 q12、q17 都是「書描寫某地生活」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 卡改 The children's drawings give a lovely depiction of their town.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B：portrayal 卡與閱讀都是「女演員演角色獲肯定」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 卡改 Some readers did not like the novel's portrayal of teenagers.，釋義第一義改「描寫」對上例句

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長裁示：中文欄人名一律保留英文名，不音譯
執行長第②③關裁示修正：「portray 常用 portray A as B」屬「常用 X」寫法卻沒有「例如…等」（準則 §11-23）；批改時 portray the city as a friendly place 以外的正確寫法（例如 shows the city to be…、被動式）不應被誤判。建議改「例如 portray A as B 等」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示評分要點統一改「例如…等」：portray 表示「把…描繪成」，用法例如 portray A as B、be portrayed as 等／「紀錄片」可寫，例如 documentary、film 等／「友善的地方」可寫，例如 a friendly place、a welcoming place 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：portray 表示「把…描繪成」，用法例如 portray A as B、be portrayed as 等／「紀錄片」可寫，例如 documentary、film 等／「友善的地方」可寫，例如 a friendly place、a welcoming place 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（depict）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u21-l01-q17；目標字沿用 depict
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「這幅壁畫描繪了農夫在田裡收割稻子的情景。」、hintWords ["depict"]、referenceEn ["This wall painting depicts farmers harvesting rice in the fields.","The painting on the wall depicts a scene of farmers cutting rice in the fields."]、rubricZh ["「描繪」用 depict（例如 depicts farmers harvesting rice 等）","「壁畫」可寫，例如 wall painting、the painting on the wall 等","「收割稻子」可寫，例如 harvesting rice、cutting rice 等"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 depict 造一個句子，說說一部你喜歡的電影、書或畫描繪了什麼。」、referenceEn ["My favorite painting depicts a quiet street after the rain.","The book I am reading depicts life in a big city long ago."]）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長裁示：第③關：c1-u21-l01-q17 SUS 與同課 q16「紀錄片把城市描繪成⋯」同為作品描繪某事、句型相同（§12.3），換成人＋depict
